key_idea: Count the white squares in each shape, then add them up.
steps: The long row has 3 white squares.
The plus shape has 1 white square, in the middle.
The tall L shape has 3 white squares. The last shape has 3 white squares.

choice_feedback.A: 8 is too few. Count again shape by shape: 3 + 1 + 3 + 3.
choice_feedback.B: 9 is 1 too few. Count again shape by shape: 3 + 1 + 3 + 3.
choice_feedback.C: 11 is 1 too many. The plus shape has only 1 white square.
choice_feedback.E: 12 is too many. Count again shape by shape: 3 + 1 + 3 + 3.
